paragraphs.text: Lord Balo Kailo (KAY-loh ) was the best tracker in the Order of the Knights of Kjeldor , during the Ice Age on Dominaria . He was the former lover of Zaraya . He had one arm and eye.

Kailo ended his relationship with Zaraya when their son, Severin , died after an order given by Zaraya. He lost his right arm and eye. He joined Zaraya when Prince Darien ordered that Zaraya and a band of warriors help the Marked Ones of Balduvia . He attended Freyalise ’s World Spell .
